vault_door.title: Bank vault | Armored Door | Low poly
vault_door.author: tasha.kosaykina

hinge_hint.note: Use vault_door_frame.glb + vault_door_leaf.glb placed at the same transform. Leaf is modeled OPEN (swung toward -Z). Put the leaf under a pivot Node3D at the hinge point, offset the leaf by -point, and rotate the pivot about +Y by about -90 deg to CLOSE (plug moves into the round opening, centered ~x=0.25,y=1.22,r~1.2m). Hinge position is estimated from geometry: tune visually. Corridor/outside side is -Z (the side the door opens toward).

vault_door.notes_extra: full model has the door OPEN; slab front face at z~0.9, slab spans x -1.98..1.98; alpha: lambert2SG:BLEND (small glass part)
